title: Push Pull Legs Upper Lower
author: Akash P.
desc: This 5-day program focuses on building muscle and strength through a structured Push Pull Legs Upper Lower split. Each workout lasts approximately 50 minutes, incorporating essential exercises like the Romanian Deadlift and various machine presses. Designed for beginners, you'll develop foundational strength while enhancing overall fitness. Expect noticeable gains in muscle tone and endurance by the end of the week.
